reject: universal person, harmony, reciprocity, good-life or relation schemas
portfolio_decision.stop: GPC-09 closes this bounded international comparison program. Do not add another regional lane merely to increase coverage; reopen only for a named reader task, material omitted structure or qualified source correction.

product_value.reader: A reader beginning with a philosophical question or source-local distinction.
product_value.job: Find the nearest Factorium owner and see what structure, language, authority or translation does not carry across.
product_value.current_friction: Claim/evidence stops before epistemic standing; information stops before semantic meaning; citations stop before performance and community custody.
product_value.smallest_product_change: Design two canonical boundaries and one derived custody view before considering any broader philosophy content.
product_value.evidence_now: One-pass structural recurrence, conflict retention, custody validation and repository checks.
product_value.evidence_later: Qualified tradition/community review and external reader comprehension, findability and return-use evidence.
product_value.cost_and_displacement: The next batch adds at most two boundaries and one view; it defers ten broad families, named-tradition navigation and another coverage campaign.
product_value.continue_merge_stop: Continue with the three-item design batch; merge no source-local records; stop the international campaign.
